brief.objective: Eliminate opposing units before the episode limit; no production or reinforcements.

public_map_facts.scope: Literal fixed initialization in the map assets, not runtime enemy observations. Spawn anchors are not exact per-unit positions. Not a complete Galaxy evaluator; custom unit overrides are not inferred from unused XML entries.

terrain.source: game_info.start_raw ImageData, row-major [y,x] -> world [x,y], no y flip; pathing matches action-mask grid
terrain.geometry_units: World unit grid cells; all intervals are half-open. +x east, +y north. Walkable spans give exact openings at cell resolution, not clearance for a unit radius. Static terrain ignores moving units. Air movement is not constrained by ground pathing.

opponent.behavior: After the wait, repeatedly attack-move toward the fixed destination. Upstream base Medivacs follow the allied centroid on mixed maps. For 2vr_vs_3sc, base issues no commands and relies on automatic Spore Crawler attacks.

action_contract.attack_candidate_rule: Living, visible, compatible targets within center distance 6; use supplied criteria. This SMAC cap is independent of native weapon range and cooldown.
action_contract.range_estimate: Center distance <= native weapon range + both unit radii. null means unknown; geometry alone does not guarantee line of sight, weapon firing or an available action.
action_contract.attack_order: Approach if needed, fire when ready; accepted is not fired.
action_contract.actions: 0 dead only; 1 Stop cancels order; 2/3/4/5 N/S/E/W movement endpoints; 6+j attack visible e{j}, or heal u{j} for Medivacs. No hold-order choice.

unknowns: Complete effects of all custom map data
brief.live_visibility: Enemy health and positions during play still come only from allied vision.

prompt:
You are GPT-6 Astra, the tactical planner for SMAC-Hard StarCraft II micro.
Return only the requested JSON plan. Do not use tools, inspect files, browse,
write code, or ask questions. All supplied facts are in INPUT JSON.
Create ONE concise map-level plan for JEV to execute across three independent
episodes on this map. You will NOT be called again during combat. Write in English,
about 250-450 words, at most 6000 JSON UTF-8 bytes. Each text field <=1000 characters;
each list <=6 entries, each entry <=500 characters; unit_roles <=12 entries.
Describe conditional tactics and unit-type roles, not a sequence of per-frame
actions or instructions tied to ephemeral unit tags, game_loop values, or one
episode's positions. JEV sees the full plan alongside its current observation on
EVERY decision. The initial observation is a snapshot, not enduring ground truth.
SC2 realtime=False: the whole game pauses while either model thinks; after JEV's
team decision, both teams advance exactly step_mul game loops. JEV chooses one
legal action per living ally; small teams share one HTTP request, larger teams
share a snapshot but are batched. Units cannot see other units' pending choices.
Give deterministic coordination rules using the supplied features where helpful.
Actions are fixed: 1 Stop cancels the current order; 2 north/+y, 3 south/-y,
4 east/+x, 5 west/-x move by move_amount; 6+j attacks visible enemy e{j}.
Medivacs instead use 6+j to heal allied u{j}, only if a legal heal candidate exists.
0 is dead-unit no-op, not a choice for living units. There is no hold-previous-order
choice. An attack order approaches if needed and fires when ready. Available attack
does NOT mean already in weapon range. Movement can interrupt attacks. Abilities,
spells, transformations, blink, stim, burrow, siege mode and arbitrary coordinates
are unavailable. No production, economy, reinforcements, or macro bot is involved.
Use current health/shields, weapon cooldown, ranges, target compatibility, distances,
energy and candidate endpoints. Do not invent measurements absent from the input.
Only shared allied vision is provided; unseen enemies are unknown, not dead.
scenario_brief supplies public fixed map rosters, spawn anchors, verified opponent
configuration, exact static walkable spans, components and height spans. These are
map priors, never current hidden enemy positions. Unknown fields remain unknown.
Attack criteria retain the SMAC center-distance cap of 6 even when native range
is longer; range null means unknown. A ready weapon in range can still have no
legal attack choice. Large batches preserve team_core columns for ALL allies,
including cooldown, maximum health/shield, energy, recent damage and current orders,
plus per-enemy legal/ready coverage counts; local relations and candidate endpoints
exist only for batch actors. No same-frame reservations or shared pending choices.
last_action_result supplies previous SC2 acceptance/rejection and observation
errors; acceptance does not prove firing. Order records retain raw IDs/tags and
human-readable actions/targets. Do not rely on missing teammate local relations,
precise future motion, attack periods, upgrades/buff damage, or hidden state.
Recommend only tactics possible through this action
space. JEV selects all concrete actions; the plan is guidance, not a local script.

plan.objective: Win each independent episode by eliminating all three enemy Marines within 60 decisions. Concentrate fire to secure the first kill while preserving three allied weapons.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until contact, keeping the leading Marine close enough for both teammates to join immediately. The opponent eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; meet that approach without chasing east alone. Use current visibility to replace spawn-based expectations. The battlefield is flat and open within x=[2,30), y=[7,25); there is no height advantage or choke to seek.
plan.target_selection: Choose one shared focus target from visible enemies: prefer targets currently in weapon range with legal attacks for the most allies, then lowest health, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Retain an existing shared target when its coverage is tied and it remains practical to finish. Each Marine attacks that target when legal; if doing so would require approaching while another enemy is already shootable, fire at the best locally shootable target instead. Do not split fire based on assumed teammate shots or unverified lethal damage.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: A ready Marine with a legal in-range target normally attacks. Reissue the selected attack during cooldown unless repositioning clearly protects a threatened unit; Stop cancels orders. Legal attacks can require approach because the candidate cap is 6 while native range is 5 plus radii. Do not kite the whole team continuously: equal-speed Marines and eight-loop advances make lost firing opportunities costly. Evaluate supplied cardinal endpoints, avoid boundaries, and preserve teammate support.
priorities: Keep all available weapons contributing; finish an accessible wounded enemy before spreading damage.
Select at most one retreating Marine: among allies taking recent damage, choose lowest health fraction, then greatest recent health loss, then lowest ally index.

That Marine retreats during cooldown only when a legal endpoint increases separation from threatening enemies without isolating it. Prefer proximity to the other allies; break endpoint ties by action ID.
Other Marines maintain pressure. Rejoin fire once pressure drops; near the time limit, prioritize attacks and pursuit over repeated retreats.
contingencies: If the focus disappears, reassess visible targets; disappearance is not a confirmed kill. With no enemies visible, search together toward last observed contact, otherwise the center.
If retreat offers no useful separation, attack rather than oscillate. If an action is rejected, select from current legal criteria; acceptance alone does not establish firing.
assumptions: Apply this policy independently across episodes. Current observations override initial positions; no healing, abilities, upgrades, or hidden enemy state are assumed.

unit_roles.guidance: Every Marine is a damage dealer. Healthier allies sustain the firing line while the single threatened ally briefly withdraws; roles change with observed damage and health.

plan.objective: Win each independent episode by eliminating all three enemy Marines within 60 decisions. Concentrate fire to secure the first kill while preserving three allied weapons.

plan.target_selection: Choose one shared focus target from visible enemies: prefer targets currently in weapon range with legal attacks for the most allies, then lowest health, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Retain an existing shared target when its coverage is tied and it remains practical to finish. Each Marine attacks that target when legal; if doing so would require approaching while another enemy is already shootable, fire at the best locally shootable target instead. plan.movement_and_cooldowns: A ready Marine with a legal in-range target normally attacks. Retain an existing shared target when its coverage is tied and it remains practical to finish. Each Marine attacks that target when legal; if doing so would require approaching while another enemy is already shootable, fire at the best locally shootable target instead. plan.movement_and_cooldowns: A ready Marine with a legal in-range target normally attacks. Evaluate supplied cardinal endpoints, avoid boundaries, and preserve teammate support.

contingencies: If the focus disappears, reassess visible targets; disappearance is not a confirmed kill. With no enemies visible, search together toward last observed contact, otherwise the center.

assumptions: Apply this policy independently across episodes. Current observations override initial positions; no healing, abilities, upgrades, or hidden enemy state are assumed.

Each Marine attacks that target when legal; if doing so would require approaching while another enemy is already shootable, fire at the best locally shootable target instead. Do not split fire based on assumed teammate shots or unverified lethal damage.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: A ready Marine with a legal in-range target normally attacks. Reissue the selected attack during cooldown unless repositioning clearly protects a threatened unit; Stop cancels orders. Legal attacks can require approach because the candidate cap is 6 while native range is 5 plus radii. Do not kite the whole team continuously: equal-speed Marines and eight-loop advances make lost firing opportunities costly. Evaluate supplied cardinal endpoints, avoid boundaries, and preserve teammate support.
priorities: Keep all available weapons contributing; finish an accessible wounded enemy before spreading damage.
Select at most one retreating Marine: among allies taking recent damage, choose lowest health fraction, then greatest recent health loss, then lowest ally index.

contingencies: If the focus disappears, reassess visible targets; disappearance is not a confirmed kill. With no enemies visible, search together toward last observed contact, otherwise the center.
